datasets.name: Dscontracts
datasets.sql:
select a.id,a.ammount,cust.name as musteri, a.contract_name,a.status,a.main_acc_id from ins_investment_contracts a,customers cust
where a.kli_id=cust.id and a.id=:cid

datasets.name: DsInvest
datasets.sql:
select c.rowid,c.* from ins_invest_payment c
where c.id=:pid

datasets.name: DsMain
datasets.sql:
select a.id,a.cid,a.ammount,a.dat,ic.contract_name,a.trid from ins_invest_payment a,ins_investment_contracts ic 
where a.cid=ic.id and (a.trid in(select id from lazytransaction) or a.trid in (select id from provarch))
and a.cid=:pcid

datasets.name: ds_sum
datasets.sql:
select nvl(sum(ammount),0)as cem  from ins_invest_payment
where cid=:p_cid

datasets.name: ds_main_acc_no
datasets.sql:
select a.id,a.acc_no from ins_investment_contracts iic,account a
where iic.main_acc_id=a.id and  iic.id=:p_id

datasets.name: ds_kassa
datasets.sql:
select a.acc_no,a.id from ins_investment_acc_bal_cn ib,account a
where dict_id=4 and a.bal_cn1=ib.bal_cn and a.acc_no is not null
